title: $1,000 in Eli Lilly in 2015 is now worth this
caption:
In 2015, Eli Lilly was an old drug maker.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:LLY:2015-01-02} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Eli Lilly in 2015? 👇
